title: Spot suspicious messages
summary: Phishing is a trick that tries to make someone reveal information or take a harmful action. Pause when a message pressures you to act quickly.
introduction: Phishing is a trick that tries to make someone reveal information or take a harmful action. Pause when a message pressures you to act quickly. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Phishing is a trick that tries to make someone reveal information or take a harmful action. Pause when a message pressures you to act quickly.

blocks.code:
Message: Your school files vanish in 5 minutes! Send your password now.
Safer response: do not reply; contact the school through a known channel.
blocks.title: Spot suspicious messages

blocks.text: The urgent threat and request for a password are warning signs.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a calm response plan for a suspicious message without replying to its sender.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A familiar logo or display name does not prove who sent a message.
For more detail later, use this [Cybersecurity Fundamentals further reading](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world).
